summary: Canaan Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing receipt of an additional 180-day compliance period from Nasdaq, extending the deadline to January 11, 2027, to regain compliance with the minimum bid price of $1.00 per ADS. The ADSs, each representing 15 Class A ordinary shares, continue trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market under symbol CAN. The company meets all other listing requirements. This is a routine listing compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms, M&A, or strategic change is involved. Watch for the bid price to close above $1.00 for ten consecutive days to cure the deficiency.
